profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Aviagen
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer with expertise in full-stack development, data analytics, and scalable application design, combined with a strong background in agricultural science. Holds an M.S. in Animal Science and previously led a swine research department, bringing firsthand experience with agricultural operations and research data management. Skilled at translating real-world agricultural challenges into software solutions that improve efficiency, decision-making, and data insights. Proven ability to lead projects from concept to deployment while collaborating across technical and domain teams to deliver impactful AgTech solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Design · C# · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Web Development · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Senior Research Manager
positions.description: Worked with a team to develop research protocols for studies. Oversee a team of applied researchers to conduct the studies in various research farms and environments. Created financial budgets for studies and worked with accountants for department budgets and finances.

positions.title: Outcomes Research Manager
positions.description: I work with swine nutrition and healthcare experts within our company and across the industry to design research studies that provide essential data on a commercial scale. Our goal is to be the leading partners in animal health and protein production.
